01 / THE IDEA

Active monitoring.
A clear path to the owner.

HSK Contract Watchdog is designed to flag potential vulnerabilities as contracts appear on testnet and mainnet. The agent looks for contact details on the contract and tries to reach the owner first. When no contact is available, a watch portal warning makes the owner wallet address visible and calls for action.

03 / TWO PATHS TO THE OWNER

Contact when possible.
Warn when unreachable.

A / CONTACT AVAILABLE

Reach out first.

Use contact details available on the contract.

  • The agent checks for owner contact details
  • It attempts to notify the owner directly
  • The alert asks the owner to take action
Direct contact is the first step when available.
B / NO CONTACT AVAILABLE

Make the warning visible.

Publish a warning on the watch portal.

  • Show the owner wallet address
  • Flag the need to review the contract
  • Ask the owner to take action
No contact details? The warning still has a place.

A flag indicates a potential vulnerability that needs review. It does not establish that a contract has been exploited.
